title: Add more and easier levels to Cardano Capture the Flag (CTF)

ms.promise:
During this phase, we will use the framework of Cardano CTF to create 2 more tasks where smart contract security mindset can be taught. Most of the tasks should be somewhat easier to solve. The story behind the tasks and the vulnerabilities taught is not limited upfront as it is part of the milestone to brainstorm interesting smart contract and vulnerabilities, but it should be clear that it serves this education purpose once delivered.
For each task, there will be vulnerable smart contracts, thorough documentation documenting both the code in necessary places and explaining the task. Additionally, there will be off-chain code that runs the task by deploying it in the emulator and in the testnet. Finally, there will be tests testing whether the contract has been "hacked".
The standard of output, acceptance criteria and evidence of milestone completion should follow the previous delivery.
Blogs are required part of only some milestones. There is no blog necessary for this milestone.
ms.criteria:
・Delivery in the Github CTF repository of 2 additional tasks where users have to exploit a vulnerability. Each of the tasks will consist of three parts (1) vulnerable smart contract, (2) off chain code to deploy and interact with the contract, (3) documentation to help understand the code and (4) tests testing the level completion.
・Delivery of documentation for each of the 2 additional sample tasks that explains the level and allows users of the code to deploy, execute and test the smart contract
・Announce the tasks on our Discord server.
ms.report:
See the open source repository containing all the things listed in the milestone: https://github.com/Invariant-0/cardano-ctf/
From the changelog: 
Version 2.1.0 - [2025-09-17]
Added
・Two tasks for the easier bank CTF series: core_invariant and deposit_vulnerability.

Changed
・Scoreboard can now display both the original series and the bank series.

Everything mentioned in the milestone completion evidence can be seen there. For convenience, this is a video showing it all real-time and explaining a bit more: https://drive.proton.me/urls/KZPCXQ1PRC#NXU8WB8aucZ0 
Twitter communication is here: https://x.com/invariant0_com/status/1968487501582008661 and Discord channel also got a link to the post (Discord channel invite can be found in the README of the github repository):
=======================
Also would like to note the following slightly related breaking migration of the repository that is not explicitly stated but it is huge and allows us to deliver more up-to-date tasks (new Aiken, PlutusV3 tasks) for this CTF series:
Version 2.0.0 - [2025-09-13]
Changed
・BREAKING: Migrated from Lucid to Lucid Evolution library for better maintanance support and newer features.
・BREAKING: Replaced Deno with Node.js + Yarn for package management and task execution.
・Updated all task commands from deno run --allow-net --allow-read ./scripts/run.ts to yarn task:XX with XX being the task number.
・Scoreboard is run with yarn scoreboard now and key generation with yarn gen-keys.
・If a Blockfrost get transaction status call fails, it retries instead of failing the run.
・Migration notes: It is natural that your solutions will not run straight away after upgrading, as lucid-evolution API is a little bit different. Please check out player_template files again to see how the transaction building should work now. To double-check that all your solutions still work, you can temporarily disable testnet runs in config.ts and run all solutions in emulator by running ./scripts/run_all.sh.
